title: Westminster Abbey ~$41 vs the Temple of Heaven ~$4 | China Travel Expert
description:
Two grand halls built for a nation's biggest ceremonies — and a wild price gap. Westminster Abbey, where British monarchs are crowned, charges about £32 for an adult booked online (roughly $41). Beijing's Temple of Heaven, where Ming and Qing emperors prayed for good harvests, costs about ¥28 for the off-season through-ticket (roughly $4) that covers the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests, the Echo Wall and the Circular Mound Altar. Park-only entry is just ¥15.

That's more than ten times cheaper for a UNESCO World Heritage masterpiece.

★ Expert Tip: at the Temple of Heaven, buy the combined "through-ticket" (not just park entry) so you can actually go inside the Hall of Prayer — and note the historic halls are closed on Mondays.

天坛通票淡季约 ¥28（约 $4），含祈年殿、回音壁、圳丘；伦敦西敟嬺成人网络票约 £32（约 $41）。同是国家大典之地，价差十倍以上。
